FRIENDS’ CLUB — Do you enjoy helping people? Meet us by the school gate at four.

LOST GIFT — I found a small blue box near the farm. Is it yours? Ask me after lunch.

COOKING GROUP — Does your child like making food? Please write her name on the list.

PHOTO DAY — Bring your family photograph on Friday. Do not send the real one; a copy is fine.

WAITERS NEEDED — Can you help at the school café? Speak to Mr Hall if you have an idea.

ART ROOM — These drawings are ours. Please do not pull them off the wall.
